files.try: Expand a share, then one of its departments.
files.watch: Each branch opens from one pack file in data/, read the first time you open it. The page never downloads the whole tree.

files.try: Type budget into Search files and folders and pick a hit.
files.watch: Only the shards for the words you typed are read; the tree then opens every branch on the path to the hit.

files.try: Turn on Only changed in the last 7 days.
files.watch: Folders above a changed file stay visible, so the tree keeps its shape around the matches.

files.try: Expand a file that has an arrow, then its History and a version.
files.watch: The version's changes open as a before and after table inside the tree, under the file they belong to.

files.try: Select a row and look at the address bar of the full-screen page.
files.watch: The hash carries the row's path. Opening that address expands straight to the row.

inventory.watch: The heading keeps its count and its patch level summary; collapsed rows still count in selections and exports.

inventory.try: Open the filter in the Site or Operating system header and tick a few values.
inventory.watch: The value counts come from all 1,200 devices that match, not from the rows on screen.

inventory.try: Read the totals row under the grid, then filter.
inventory.watch: Average and lowest patch level follow the filtered query.

inventory.try: Tick a few rows, then use Select all matching.
inventory.watch: The status bar counts the selection. Select all matching captures the query instead of every record ID.

inventory.try: Open Export and choose Download CSV.
inventory.watch: Pick filtered, selected or all records. The file follows the accepted query and the column order, not the visible rows.

inventory.try: Hide a column, then open Views and save the layout.
inventory.watch: Named views keep columns, filters and sorting, and Reset view returns to the definition.

calendar.try: Switch between Month, Week, 3 days, Agenda and Year.
calendar.watch: Every view reads the same grid records; search, filters and saved views carry across.

calendar.try: Find the daily stand-up and the weekly maintenance window, then open one occurrence.
calendar.watch: Series come from a recurrence rule, with one skipped date and one moved occurrence kept as exceptions.

calendar.try: Look at the change freeze and the company holiday in month view.
calendar.watch: Ranges shade the days behind the events instead of competing with them.
The record opens in the panel with its ticket, owner and notes, the same panel the grid uses.

timeline.try: Collapse a site, then a role, in the tree on the left.
timeline.watch: Each resource shows its event count and busy hours; group rows roll them up.

timeline.try: Look along the group rows for amber and red cells.
timeline.watch: Group rows turn amber, then red, as more events run at the same time.

timeline.try: Drag an incident onto another host in the same role.
timeline.watch: Moves go through the grid's editing contract; a move that would overlap is refused.

matrix.watch: Rows and columns without a critical or warning cell fold away, and the totals follow.
The heading keeps its server count and its totals while its rows are hidden.

matrix.try: Search for a service or a server, then scroll both ways.
matrix.watch: Only the cells on screen are in the page, so wide matrices stay quick.

changes.try: Turn on Flagged only, then open agent.exe.
changes.watch: The details list why each flag is raised, with the versions side by side.

changes.try: Open map-drives.ps1 and switch between Inline and Side by side.
changes.watch: The changed words are marked inside each replaced line; folded lines open where they are.
FS04 has not got the change yet, FS05 holds a different file and FS06 has not reported: three different states, each with its own symbol.

changes.try: Use Copy the network path on a row.
changes.watch: CanopyX copies the value and tells the host; every other action is the host's to carry out.

flow.watch: Each task opens on its own; the hub keeps its state and the host's summary line.

flow.try: Switch the engine between SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
flow.watch: The engine options are fields the host returns, so the flow asks only what that engine needs.

flow.try: Type a server name containing fail and test the connection.
flow.watch: The host's check fails with its message; a passing check lists what it found.

flow.try: Finish the required tasks, then review and submit.
flow.watch: The flow hands the host one document; secrets are read once and never echo back.

email.try: Switch the site theme in the header.
email.watch: The outline follows it through the page's --cx-* properties. In a mail client its literal colours apply.

email.try: Look for the counts after a cut branch.
email.watch: MaxRows and MaxDepth cut the outline, and each cut branch shows how many rows it hides.

email.try: Print this page or save it as PDF.
email.watch: The table is plain HTML with inline styles, so it prints and pastes into Word as it looks here.
